description: Cancel (delete) an automation schedule by its schedule ID. Unpublished slots (pending, generating, or ready) are removed so they cannot publish, and their prepaid tokens are refunded. A post already publishing or already published is not recalled. Use list_schedules to find the ID.

scheduleId.description: The ID of the schedule to cancel. Unpublished slots (pending, generating, or ready) are removed and their prepaid tokens are refunded. A post already publishing or published is not recalled.

name: cancel_schedule
